name: ProvideQ Biobanking Web RAG Benchmark
source: Peer-reviewed scientific papers indexed in PubMed and/or available through PubMed Central or the journal publisher.
description: A frozen benchmark for evaluating scientific paper retrieval and evidence extraction in biobanking and pre-analytical biospecimen handling. Every gold answer is a verbatim contiguous snippet from the cited paper. Papers were selected independently of Paperclip or any other retrieval system.
